name: Kazandu elementals
description: Dozens of elementals of the Kazandu forest of many forms who fight for Nissa and are revived by the Core.

timeline.summary: Nissa, backed by Kazandu elementals, confronts Jace and Nahiri and orders the elementals to defend Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Defend Zendikar," she said to the elementals

timeline.summary: Nahiri battles the elementals but is overwhelmed, her swords brushed aside, and retreats into the Singing City.
timeline.quote: She didn't stop until she reached the massive marble gates of the Singing City and pushed through them.

timeline.summary: The Core's power heals Zendikar, reviving the elementals and making the Eldrazi wastes bloom.
timeline.quote: Zendikar was healing, turning into something healthier, stronger than it was before the battle with the Eldrazi.

relations.note: The elementals defend and follow Nissa.
relations.quote: ready to defend her with their lives
